subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should maintainers require live Gateway memory_search outage/recovery proof before merging this PR, or explicitly override the proof gate for deterministic manager-level coverage?
rationale: The code path looks like the right narrow fix, but the contributor has only posted mocked provider-boundary test output, while OpenClaw's external-PR gate requires real after-fix behavior proof unless a maintainer overrides it.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs, live output, or a recording showing Gateway memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression as sufficient for this internal recovery path and proceed with exact-head CI/merge review.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs, live output, or a recording showing Gateway memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on memory provider-state helper extraction and is a good owner for a proof-sufficiency call on this memory-core boundary.
